rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent terraced block with a clear dominant direction, so gesture and hierarchy are solid. The stepped section is not arbitrary: it creates a legible landform and keeps the silhouette readable in all views, though it remains somewhat box-derived. The main weakness is that the public void/court is present but not emphatically opened to the verified access edge; the access response is acceptable but could be more active and explicit. Programmatically, the mass can plausibly support neighborhood living because it offers a compact street building with upper hierarchy and a usable internal void, but it still leans more toward a generic stepped block than a strongly grounded mixed-use threshold. Overall it passes, with room to strengthen the public threshold and deepen the carved void.
